title: Integrated multi-omics analyses identify anti-viral host factors and pathways controlling SARS-CoV-2 infection
model: A549-ACE2 cells, genome-wide CRISPR-KO library (92,817 guides)
contrast: SARS-CoV-2 infected vs mock, survival screen (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: Anti-viral factors depleted: V-ATPase, ESCRT, N-glycosylation, cohesin, KLF5; DAZAP2, VTA1, KLF5 validated
barcs_calls: 257 genes at FDR 0.10 (93 depleted/anti-viral, 164 enriched/pro-viral; control-null 312) after control calibration
named_hits: DAZAP2 #1 depleted (FDR 2.6e-17), KLF5 #6 (FDR 1.2e-09), VTA1 #42 (FDR 0.013, tiny effect); ESCRT and cohesin depleted; ACE2/CTSL top enriched controls
verdict: BARCS recovers the paper's two strongest validated anti-viral factors, DAZAP2 (most depleted gene) and KLF5 (#6), plus the ESCRT and cohesin modules; VTA1 passes FDR 0.10 only weakly. Non-targeting guides were inflated (18.8% at p<0.05) and the hit list was calibrated to them. Rank correlation with the deposited MAGeCK is 0.68.
